title: Review of c07's ringswim c2 (SIBM): fresh seeds 9 and 10 form ring-walled cells from noise that swim as crescents (29 tracks >= 3 BL on seed 9, 0 with mu=0) with the link ring at rim/core 1.49-1.51
summary: Verdict written before reading other reviews. I ran world_claim.py unchanged with labkit on new seeds 9 and 10 (128^2, T=20000) and c07's celltrack.py on seed 9 for the claim world and its mu=0 twin (world_mu0.py). From a noisy start, walled cells appear by t~800 and a bounded population of 10-16 round cells and crescents with depletion wakes persists to t=20000 on both seeds. celltrack seed 9: 29 track segments >= 3 BL and 10 >= 5 BL (best 6.45 BL over 3660 t); the mu=0 twin on the same seed has 0 >= 3 BL (best 2.11). labkit radial: L link rim/core 1.49 and 1.51, rim/outside 6.39 (45/64 and 36/58 individuals membrane-like), wall indicator 2.27-2.30.

observations.S: rerun/seed9/sheet.png t=0: unstructured noise over the whole domain; walled cells by t=800 (also seed 10)
observations.I: rerun/seed9/tracks.png: #22 from t=200 to 1800 and #202 t=5500-7400 keep a bounded walled body between collisions
observations.B: rerun/seed10/radial.png: L link peaks at the wall, rim/core 1.51, rim/outside 6.39 (36/58 membrane-like); seed 9 1.49 / 6.39 (45/64)
observations.M: ct_s9.json: 29 segments >= 3 BL, 10 >= 5 BL (track 54: 6.45 BL in 3660 t); ct_mu0_s9.json: 0 >= 3 BL, best 2.11 BL; rerun/seed9/tracks.png #202 and #22 become crescents that carry the pale wall/link rim at their front

verdicts.limitation: The L ring is just at the 1.5 rim/core line (1.49-1.51) and is an aggregate over all cells; I did not rerun chi=0, so B's ablation rests on the author's pack_chi0. labkit's tracker churns (merge/split 0.84, no persistent tracks) because cells collide and fuse often, so I is judged from tracks.png and celltrack segments between collisions. The drive is a per-body label average (nonlocal), as the claim says. Only seed 9 has celltrack motion numbers.
